new='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Colored runs on opposite horizontal edges encode corresponding positions.
    top = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 1]
    bottom = [(c, grid[-1][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[-1][c] != 1]
    # Locate the isolated interior marker and the edge color/run matching its ray.
    pts = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,1) and r not in (0,h-1)]
    # ARC background is whichever color fills most of the grid.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in pts if v != bg]
    if not pts or not top or not bottom: return out
    r,c,color = pts[0]
    # Edge runs of the same color define the two ends; transfer the marker's
    # offset from the first run to the opposite run.
    def run_start(edge, col):
        a=col
        while a>0 and edge[a-1]==edge[col]: a-=1
        return a
    topcols=[i for i,v in top if v==color]
    botcols=[i for i,v in bottom if v==color]
    # Border color may differ from marker; use the two edge runs as portals.
    topv=[v for v in grid[0] if v!=bg]; botv=[v for v in grid[-1] if v!=bg]
    if not topv or not botv: return out
    topc=next(i for i,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v!=bg)
    botc=next(i for i,v in enumerate(grid[-1]) if v!=bg)
    target=botc+(c-topc)
    if not (0<=target<w): target=max(0,min(w-1,target))
    out[r][c]=4
    for rr in range(h):
        if rr!=r: out[rr][target]=color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(new)
